references.limits: Bounded 5000-node nib decode is partial; resource labels do not prove live menu ordering or runtime behavior.

references.limit: Basic profile is not proof of the custom dark profile in the screenshot.

references.result: CUA explicitly denied com.apple.Terminal; no window opened, command entered, session modified or bypass attempted.

references.finding: openTab constructs a TerminalPage and immediately calls startShell. Backend wraps Konsole TerminalSession; toolkit UI is C++, not a drop-in QtQuick component.
references.reuse: Source behavior consulted; no Cutefish or Apple implementation copied into our Python PTY backend.

implemented: Automatic interactive shell per window and tab; no Start Shell toolbar
32 px titlebar with working-directory label, shell title and actual PTY geometry
ANSI color rendering, bounded 2000-row scrollback, cursor, basic alternate screen and bracketed paste
Controlling TTY, real TIOCSWINSZ resize and foreground Ctrl-C
New Window, New Tab, Close Tab, Copy/Paste/Select All, font sizing and scrollback menu actions
Owned shell cleanup at tab/window/application close
makos-fetch command with original makOS ASCII and read-only system_info inventory; emitted directly before exec, never typed as a shell command
Normal startup uses real user environment; explicit test shell fixtures disable banner and user shell profiles

validation.backend: 8 tests passed in tests/test_terminal.py, including real banner-before-prompt and captured foreground cleanup ownership checks
validation.qml: tests/verify_terminal_ui.py passed with actual no-profile /bin/sh PTYs: automatic start, keyboard command, size, tabs, separate window, history, font resize, cleanup
validation.shell_suite: 2 Terminal-specific tests passed; unrelated Finder sidebar shortcut failed in broad run and reported to root
validation.broad_smoke: tests/smoke_ui.py passed with shell startup suppressed
validation.visual: Offscreen software render of fixed fixture output inspected; native Wayland validation pending

remaining_limits: No claim of full Apple Terminal or Konsole emulator parity: split panes, profiles editor, remote connection dialog, mouse reporting, advanced terminal protocols and complete control-sequence compatibility are unimplemented.
Directory title currently reflects initial working directory; OSC title is observed but no live shell cwd tracking or inherited-current-directory new-tab behavior.
Font fallback on Linux differs from Apple SF Mono; screenshot showed a custom profile, not stock Basic.
No fabricated Apple model, OS, uptime, disk or display values. Banner includes only fields available from shared system_info backend.
Interactive shell profiles are intentionally honored for normal user launches; verification never executes them.
Actual Linux native rendering and an installed-image Terminal launch require CI/VM checks.
